reviews.t: Bright colors and can stamp SOME images.
reviews.x: I liked these polishes! You hardly need a second coat (at least with the ones I tried so far). I've also managed to use a couple in stamping but only with images that have larger with an open design. They won't transfer if you try to use them with a bunch of dots or thin lines. They will stain your nails and mat so be sure to use a good base coat first! I've not had the problem others have reported with chipping but I also use gel top coats the next day to seal and protect my designs.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wide variety of gorgeous colors in the set.
Many say the polish provides good coverage, often opaque in one coat.
Several reviewers report packaging problems, including broken or chipped bottles and flimsy boxes.
Some reviewers note the polish has a strong smell.
A few reviewers mention the polish is thick or chips quickly.
